summary: The figure is a world map showing countries and areas categorized by whether they have a national health and climate change plan or strategy in place as of 2021. Countries are color-coded into six categories: Yes, Under development, No, Unknown, Not a participant, and Not applicable. Many countries in Africa, Asia, and Europe have a plan in place, while several countries in the Americas and Oceania are under development or have no plan. Some countries are marked as unknown or not participants.
